lines.trans: So the sauce turned out very tasty, Max?
Chef, we all thought that it was good.
You foolishly lied to me straight in my face!
We simply did not want to upset you badly.
I sincerely trusted all of you always!
Forgive us, chef, this will never happen again.
From today on, tell me only the truth.
We promise to always tell the pure truth.
There will be no more foolish deceit in my kitchen!
We understood your strict main lesson.
And if someone lies, I will fire them immediately!
We are immediately beginning our new work.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('tasty, delicious').

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, присядьте. Попробуйте чай с сушками, очень вкусные.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you
на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

meanings.note: + dative of person or thing trusted

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?
Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кренне').

examples.text: Марина Сергеевна, я вам искренне сочувствую.

examples.text: Я вам искренне сочувствую, но мне пора работать.

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'someone, somebody' in everyday speech.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'чинать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to begin, to start', paired with 'начать'.

examples.text: Аркаш, ну что скажешь? Когда начинать?
examples.trans: Arkasha, so what do you say? When do I start?

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Negative prefix 'не-' ('un-, non-, not') (stem 'медленно'). Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.trans: I have no money at all.

examples.text: Да нет у тебя никаких денег.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone
